# SendInput structures for more reliable clicking
class MOUSEINPUT\(ctypes.Structure\):
    _fields_ = [
        \(''dx'', ctypes.c_long\),
        \(''dy'', ctypes.c_long\),
        \(''mouseData'', ctypes.c_ulong\),
        \(''dwFlags'', ctypes.c_ulong\),
        \(''time'', ctypes.c_ulong\),
        \(''dwExtraInfo'', ctypes.POINTER\(ctypes.c_ulong\)\)
    ]

class INPUT\(ctypes.Structure\):
    _fields_ = [
        \(''type'', ctypes.c_ulong\),
        \(''mi'', MOUSEINPUT\)
    ]

def send_click\(x, y\):
    # Move cursor
    ctypes.windll.user32.SetCursorPos\(int\(x\), int\(y\)\)
    time.sleep\(0.1\)
    
    # Use SendInput for click
    MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN = 0x0002
    MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTUP = 0x0004
    INPUT_MOUSE = 0
    
    # Left down
    extra = ctypes.c_ulong\(0\)
    inp = INPUT\(type=INPUT_MOUSE, mi=MOUSEINPUT\(0, 0, 0, MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN, 0, ctypes.pointer\(extra\)\)\)
    ctypes.windll.user32.SendInput\(1, ctypes.byref\(inp\), ctypes.sizeof\(inp\)\)
    time.sleep\(0.05\)
    
    # Left up  
    inp = INPUT\(type=INPUT_MOUSE, mi=MOUSEINPUT\(0, 0, 0, MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTUP, 0, ctypes.pointer\(extra\)\)\)
    ctypes.windll.user32.SendInput\(1, ctypes.byref\(inp\), ctypes.sizeof\(inp\)\)

import ctypes
from pywinauto import Desktop

import time

# Windows messages
WM_LBUTTONDOWN = 0x0201
WM_LBUTTONUP = 0x0202
MK_LBUTTON = 0x0001

def make_lparam\(x, y\):
    return \(y << 16\) | \(x & 0xFFFF\)

def click_window\(hwnd, x, y\):
    ''''''Send click directly to window at client coordinates''''''
    lparam = make_lparam\(x, y\)
    
    # Send mouse down
    ctypes.windll.user32.PostMessageW\(hwnd, WM_LBUTTONDOWN, MK_LBUTTON, lparam\)
    time.sleep\(0.1\)

    ctypes.windll.user32.PostMessageW\(hwnd, WM_LBUTTONUP, 0, lparam\)

import asyncio
from pywinauto import Desktop
from PIL import ImageGrab, Image

import numpy as np
import pytesseract
import re

pytesseract.pytesseract.tesseract_cmd = r''C:\\Program Files\\Tesseract-OCR\\tesseract.exe''

async def quick_scrape\(\):
    print\(''=== Quick Scrape \(No Navigation\) ===''\)
    
    desktop = Desktop\(backend=''win32''\)
    clubgg = None
    for w in desktop.windows\(\):
        try:
            if w.window_text\(\) == ''ClubGG'':
                clubgg = w
                break
        except:
            pass
    
    if not clubgg:
        print\(''ClubGG not found!''\)
        return
    
    rect = clubgg.rectangle\(\)
    clubgg.set_focus\(\)
    await asyncio.sleep\(0.3\)
    
    # Capture
    screenshot = ImageGrab.grab\(bbox=\(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom\)\)
    screenshot.save\(''D:/development/GitHub/jungleverse/quick_scrape.png''\)
    
    # OCR
    cv_img = cv2.cvtColor\(np.array\(screenshot\), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR\)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor\(cv_img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
    thresh = cv2.adaptiveThreshold\(gray, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, cv2.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2\)
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string\(Image.fromarray\(thresh\)\)
    
    print\(''Raw text:''\)
    print\(text[:500]\)
    print\(\)
    
    # Parse tournaments
    tournaments = []
    lines = text.split\(''\\n''\)
    
    current_tourney = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip\(\)
        if not line:
            if current_tourney:
                tournaments.append\(current_tourney\)
                current_tourney = {}
            continue
        
        line_lower = line.lower\(\)
        
        # Tournament name patterns
        if any\(x in line_lower for x in [''nlh'', ''plo'', ''holdem'', ''omaha'', ''freeroll'', ''turbo'']\):
            if current_tourney:
                tournaments.append\(current_tourney\)
            current_tourney = {''name'': line}
        
        # Status
        if ''registering'' in line_lower or ''late reg'' in line_lower:
            current_tourney[''status''] = ''registering''
        elif ''running'' in line_lower:
            current_tourney[''status''] = ''running''
        elif ''announced'' in line_lower:
            current_tourney[''status''] = ''announced''
        
        # Time patterns
        time_match = re.search\(r''\(\\d{1,2}\)h\\s*\(\\d{1,2}\)m'', line_lower\)
        if time_match:
            current_tourney[''starts_in''] = f''{time_match.group\(1\)}h {time_match.group\(2\)}m''
        
        time_match2 = re.search\(r''\(\\d{2}\):\(\\d{2}\)'', line\)
        if time_match2:
            current_tourney[''time''] = f''{time_match2.group\(1\)}:{time_match2.group\(2\)}''
        
        # Players
        players_match = re.search\(r''\(\\d+\)\\s*/\\s*\(\\d+\)'', line\)
        if players_match:
            current_tourney[''players''] = f''{players_match.group\(1\)}/{players_match.group\(2\)}''
        
        # Prize
        if ''stage'' in line_lower and ''ticket'' in line_lower:
            current_tourney[''prize''] = line
    
    if current_tourney:
        tournaments.append\(current_tourney\)
    
    # Filter out empty or incomplete entries
    tournaments = [t for t in tournaments if t.get\(''name''\)]
    
    print\(''=== Parsed Tournaments ===''\)
    for i, t in enumerate\(tournaments[:10]\):
        print\(f''{i+1}. {t}''\)
    
    print\(f''\\nTotal tournaments found: {len\(tournaments\)}''\)

asyncio.run\(quick_scrape\(\)\)
